story.title: Madam Amma's class
paragraphs_en: She loves taking toys and games to children. Today, her motorbike was filled with games for a fun day in the beach!
She saw Monu and Chotu climbing trees. "Come! LEt's go see where the others are so we can play with them too!" said Amma
Amma saw Rohan crying on the grass. He had hurt his foot. She quickly mended it and invited him to play.
Then Amma saw Rita, Sita and Mohan reading some books. "Come on guys! Lets go to the big old tree behind your school. I have a surprise for you there!" said Amma.

So Monu, Chotu, Rohan, Mohan, Rita and Sita went with miss Amma to the tree and found a beautiful tree house filled with toys and games! She rushed to the tree to play and hugged Amma. "Thank you miss Amma!" they said happily.
